## Data Visualization Activity

### Data

The [Xpresso model](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.celrep.2020.107663) was developed to predict gene expression from DNA sequence alone.

Raw data is available as Table S1 within the supplemental information here: [https://doi.org/10.1016/j.celrep.2020.107663](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.celrep.2020.107663)

`.csv` files are available as well for this workshop here: [https://github.com/fhdsl/itcr2026_workshops/tree/main/resources/activity_data_files](https://github.com/fhdsl/itcr2026_workshops/tree/main/resources/activity_data_files)

* `xpresso_validations_predications.csv` provides experimentally known / validated expression for a variety of Human cell types as well as the model predicted expression values for some of these cell types.
* `celltype_codebook.csv` provides a code book that defines which cell type each column corresponds with


### Description of data

The available data includes experimentally known gene expression in several cell types as well as predicted gene expression for those cell types.

### Activity description

In this activity, we are going to perform several exploratory data visualization steps. Then, we will build and polish an expository data visualization.
